title: Can we rename "HbA1c est" to "GMI", and update the formula?
symptom: The HbA1c estimation in xDrip is based on average glucose over selected time periods (e.g., today, 7 days) which is not statistically valid for estimating A1C, as A1C reflects average glucose over the past 90 days. This could mislead users.
cause: The formula used for HbA1c estimation is applied to averages over periods shorter than 90 days, which is an incorrect use of the formula.
fix: The thread discusses renaming 'HbA1c est' to 'GMI' and updating the formula, but no final resolution was reached. The issue was put on hold pending wider adoption of GMI.
evidence_quote: I have put a hold on this to see if the new (updated) formula is used universally or not. We should not update if no one picks it up.
